title: MSc in Experiential Digital Marketing Communications
text:
About the Programme
Purpose: To empower ambitious students and professionals to master digital storytelling, navigate the data-driven marketing landscape, and lead brands in delivering meaningful, memorable experiences to the connected consumer.
Mission: To foster a student-centric, innovation-driven learning environment where individuals thrive academically, professionally, and personally. The programme develops:

Advanced skills in AI, data analytics, IoT, and phygital marketing.
Essential soft skills such as adaptability, agility, resilience, and collaboration.
The capacity to create sustainable value in an ever-evolving digital landscape.

Key Features:

Flexible Learning: Hybrid programme with intensive five-week modules combining weekend classes, online seminars, and self-paced content for working professionals.
Cross-Disciplinary Approach: Integrates technology, psychology, analytics, design, and communication for strategic, well-rounded marketing expertise.
Continuous Growth: Develops self-directed learning skills to help graduates adapt and thrive in evolving digital marketing landscapes.

title: Programme Structure
text:
Language
English



Tuition Fees
€7,500 (total)



Duration
3 semesters




The MSc in Experiential Digital Marketing Communications comprises 10 courses delivered as intensive five-week modules combining weekend classes, online seminars, and self-paced content.






Value-Based Marketing





Students master cutting-edge marketing strategies by analyzing real-world cases, developing data-driven insights, and designing customer-centric campaigns. They leave prepared to drive growth, build powerful brands, and lead innovation in dynamic global markets.
Objective: Understand and apply value-driven marketing strategies.









Agile and Sustainable Marketing Strategies





Students explore ethical marketing, sustainability, and stakeholder engagement, gaining the tools to lead with integrity in a connected world. They learn to manage responsible communication and promote digital well-being.
Objective: Master agility, sustainability, and ethics in marketing.









Experiential Marketing





Students learn to design experiential marketing campaigns that blend physical and digital touchpoints. They apply technologies like Big Data, AI, and X-realities to create engaging, interactive brand experiences.
Objective: Learn to create interactive, hybrid brand experiences.









Data and Digital Literacy





Students develop hands-on expertise with R by analyzing real consumer data, extracting actionable insights, and applying advanced methods like conjoint analysis. They finish by delivering an independent marketing project.
Objective: Develop skills in data-driven marketing analysis using R.









Internet of Things (IoT) in Marketing





Students investigate how IoT devices, X-realities, and mobile apps transform consumer behavior and market intelligence. Through hands-on workshops, they design personalized consumer experiences integrating innovation with social responsibility.
Objective: Learn to leverage IoT, X-realities, and mobile apps in marketing.









Data Analysis and AI





Students acquire skills to analyze data and leverage digital tools, including gamified applications and AR technologies, to extract actionable consumer insights and inform strategic marketing decisions.
Objective: Apply AI tools and digital media analysis in marketing.









Content Creation and Management





Students gain practical skills using Google Forms and RStudio to design surveys, analyze data, and create visually compelling dashboards. They acquire hands-on experience in content management and data visualization.
Objective: Develop skills in creating engaging digital content and visualizations.









Reputation and Media Management





Students develop the skills to manage public image, communication channels, and stakeholder relationships. They engage with public relations, guerrilla marketing, and crisis communication to protect brand reputation.
Objective: Master techniques for managing brand reputation.









Academic Research Design and Consulting Practice





Students learn research design, data collection methods, and consulting practices through hands-on projects. They tackle real-world consulting scenarios, culminating in a research or consulting proposal.
Objective: Develop skills in research design and consulting.









Special Topics





Students engage with contemporary trends in experiential digital marketing, analyzing the latest research and industry practices. They develop critical skills to evaluate the impact of marketing strategies on societal outcomes.
Objective: Explore trends and issues in experiential digital marketing.
